archetype: The Performance Pro & Tactical Command (Mobile-First Vehicle Management)

entry_surfaces./: mobile-first vehicle hero with quick action dashboard preview, financial telemetry cards and immediate trial CTA
entry_surfaces./login: split branded command login — mobile tactical vehicle passcard top, credentials & Google OAuth bottom
entry_surfaces./onboarding: tactical 5-step vehicle telemetry setup wizard with large touch targets and instant km/L & state fuel estimation
entry_surfaces./dashboard: dense command grid — monthly burn rate, daily cost, cost/km ticker, maintenance urgency radar and PRO reserve fund
entry_surfaces./checkout: high-converting pricing matrix — Anual R$149,90 featured badge, Mensal and Pix with live EMV copy-paste and QR code modal
entry_surfaces./admin: compact administrative approval ledger for Pix confirmations and PRO lifetime activations

logo_and_brand_spec.tagline: Gestão Inteligente & Previsão de Custo por KM
logo_and_brand_spec.icon_structure: Geometric tachometer / speedometer needle fused with a precision geometric hexagonal lock and neon emerald chevron

mobile_first_touch_targets.vehicle_selector_buttons: 3 large responsive cards for Moto, Carro, Caminhão with rich iconography, active emerald ring, and subtle tactile haptics

onboarding_wizard_steps: Passo 1: Tipo de Veículo (Moto / Carro / Caminhão)
Passo 2: Marca, Modelo, Ano e Hodômetro (km atual)
Passo 3: Aquisição (Quitado/À vista vs Financiado com parcela e meses restantes)
Passo 4: Consumo sugerido (km/L) e preço médio de combustível por estado (com fallback e GPS)
Passo 5: Rotina de uso (km/dia e dias da semana ativos)
dashboard_widgets: Total Gasto Mensal Estimado (Combustível + Manutenção Proporcional + Financiamento)
Custo Diário de Rodagem e Custo Real por KM (R$/km)
Fundo de Reserva Diário Sugerido (PRO feature)
Radar de Manutenções Preventivas (Óleo, Pneus, Pastilhas, Correia/Relação com status em km e tempo)

checkout_and_pix.pix_features: Geração dinâmica de QR Code + Código Copia e Cola EMV + Botão Copiar com toast 'Copiado!' + Botão 'Já realizei o pagamento' que seta status 'Pendente' para validação do Admin

admin_panel.features: Lista de pagamentos pendentes com comprovante/id, botões de 'Aprovar PRO' e 'Rejeitar', e badge PRO Vitalício garantido para rodriguesdewon@gmail.com

motion_and_interactions.card_hover: transition: transform 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease
motion_and_interactions.onboarding_slide: staggered slide-in from right with spring physics

accessibility.touch_size: Minimum 48px touch targets for mobile accessibility
accessibility.apca_contrast: All text tokens meet 4.5:1 on their respective dark backgrounds
accessibility.testing_attributes: All buttons, inputs, modals and status pills must have explicit data-testid attributes

2. Ensure all 5 onboarding steps work seamlessly and calculate real-time cost-per-km previews.
3. Support quick demo auto-fill or vehicle presets so the user can test instant calculations.
4. Implement Pix QR code simulation with EMV Copia e Cola, copy feedback toast, and Admin payment approval queue.
5. Automatically give Lifetime PRO to the account 'rodriguesdewon@gmail.com'.
6. Make sure language switcher (PT-BR/EN/ES) and currency formatting react instantly.
7. Include high-contrast charts (Recharts) for cost distribution: Combustível, Manutenção e Parcela.
